scientific_integrity: Analytic proof of the infinite-series law and tails; exact finite checker corroborates but does not replace proof. External independent scientific assessment not performed.
scientific_limitations: Stationary, one-dimensional, constant positive drift and diffusivity, rate-r homogeneous Poisson resets and deterministic negative contraction. No finite-time first-passage or non-Poisson result. Possible implicit priority coverage by broad signed affine-perpetuity tail literature remains a risk.
title: A sharp reflected-excursion transition in drifted diffusion with sign-reversing proportional resetting
